helpDesc: Find answers to common questions about government eligibility matching, application workflows, and security.
faqQ1: How do I know which schemes I am eligible for?
faqA1: Use our Eligibility Checker tool. Just answer a few simple questions about your age, income, occupation, and state, and we'll show you a personalized list of matching schemes instantly.
faqQ2: Is SchemeSetu an official government website?
faqA2: SchemeSetu is a citizen-assistance platform that aggregates publicly available information from official government portals like MyScheme.gov.in, Scholarships.gov.in, and others. We are not directly affiliated with the Government of India, but all scheme data is sourced from official sources.
faqQ3: Can I apply for a scheme directly through SchemeSetu?
faqA3: No. SchemeSetu helps you discover and understand schemes, check your eligibility, and prepare your documents. For the actual application, we redirect you to the official government portal for that specific scheme. This ensures your application is processed through official channels.
faqQ4: How often is the scheme data updated?
faqA4: Scheme data is refreshed from the official sources from time to time, not in real time. A scheme's details may have changed since we last updated, so always confirm on the official portal before you apply.
faqQ5: Is my personal data safe on SchemeSetu?
faqA5: Your profile (the answers you enter) is saved in your account so we can match schemes for you. We use Google sign-in and never store your password.
faqQ6: What documents are generally required for most schemes?
faqA6: Most central government schemes require: Aadhaar Card, Bank Account (linked to Aadhaar), Income Certificate (from Tehsildar/SDM), Caste Certificate (if applicable), Age Proof (Birth Certificate or Class 10 Marksheet), Address Proof, Passport-sized photographs. Always check the specific scheme's document list for exact requirements.

pvWho: SchemeSetu is an independent information service that helps people find and understand Indian government schemes. It is not a government website and is not run by, or connected to, any government body.
pvSignInH: What we collect when you sign in
pvSignIn: You sign in with your Google account. From Google we receive and store your Google account ID, your email address, your name and the link to your profile photo. We never see or store your Google password. You do not need to sign in to use the guest eligibility checker.
pvProfile1: If you sign in you can fill in a profile: name, age, date of birth, gender, occupation, education, annual family income, social category, state, district, rural or urban residence, whether you belong to a minority community, have a disability, are a widow or widower, are a military veteran, are a farmer or own cultivable land, and interest tags. Only your name is required. Some of these answers are sensitive. Leave anything you prefer not to share blank: schemes are still shown, and we tell you which conditions we could not check.
pvProfile2: We also store the schemes you bookmark.
pvWhy: We use it only to keep you signed in, to match schemes to your answers, and to show your bookmarks. We do not sell it and we do not use it for advertising.
pvGuestH: The guest eligibility checker and SetuAI
pvGuest: The answers you give the eligibility checker are sent to our server to find matching schemes. The messages you type to SetuAI are sent to our server to choose a ready-made answer. Neither is saved on our server.
pvCookie: After you sign in we set one cookie that keeps you signed in for up to 7 days. It is used only for that. We use no advertising or tracking cookies and no analytics. Your browser also keeps some data on your device: your language and theme, whether the side menu is collapsed, a copy of your name, email and photo link so pages can show them, your bookmarks, and your SetuAI chat history. You can clear all of it from Settings, or by clearing your browser data.
pvStored: Your account, profile and bookmarks are stored in the database that runs the service.
pvLogs: The server keeps ordinary logs of each request: the time, the address requested (which can include search words), the result and how long it took. It does not log your profile answers or the contents of your messages. Our hosting providers may also record your IP address as part of running the service, and we use your IP address in memory to limit repeated requests.
pvThird: Google: you sign in with Google, and whenever you open the site your browser loads Google's sign-in script and fonts from Google's servers, so Google can see that your device visited. Groq: to translate scheme text into Hindi and Gujarati we send the public text of government schemes to Groq's translation service. We send no user data to Groq: no names, emails, profile answers or messages.
pvDelete: At the moment the app has no button to delete your account or to download your data. You can sign out, and you can clear what is saved in your browser from Settings. Removing your account and data from our database is not yet available.
pvChange: If we change how we handle data, we will update this page and its date.
tmWhat: SchemeSetu is an independent information service. It helps you find and understand Indian government schemes and check roughly whether you may be eligible. It is not a government website, it is not connected to any government body, and it does not accept applications. To apply, you are sent to the official portal.
tmInfo: Scheme details come from published sources and are refreshed from time to time, so they may be out of date or incomplete. Eligibility results are an indication, not a decision, and a scheme being shown does not mean you will receive it. Always confirm the details, and apply, on the official portal.
tmTrans: Hindi and Gujarati text is translated by a machine and may contain mistakes. The English original is always available, and the English text is the one to rely on.
tmAi: SetuAI gives ready-made answers about a few common schemes. It is not a live assistant and its answers are not advice.
tmAcct: You sign in with Google. Keep your Google account secure; you are responsible for what happens under your sign-in. Give accurate answers if you want accurate matches.
tmUse: Please use the service for its intended purpose. Do not try to break it, overload it, or collect its data in bulk.
tmChange: The service is provided as it is, free of charge, and may change, be interrupted or stop at any time.
tmLiab: To the extent the law allows, we are not responsible for decisions you make, or benefits you miss, because of information on this site. Nothing here is legal, financial or professional advice.
tmPriv: How we handle your data is described in the Privacy Policy.
